name: Isabel Wiseler-Lima - § 50 - Am 17
title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2024
part_text: 1. Reasserts the universality and indivisibility of human rights and the inherent dignity of every human being; reaffirms the duty of the EU and its Member States to promote and protect democracy and the universality of human rights around the world; stresses that gender equality is a core value of the EU and one of its common and fundamental principles;
